name: Differential Diffusion (soft mask)
plain: Lets a greyscale mask act as a per-pixel denoise strength. At each step only pixels whose mask value exceeds a falling threshold can change, so regions join the edit at different times. Core adds a strength blend back to the soft mask.
math:
thr = (t(σ) − t(σ_to))/(t(σ_0) − t(σ_to)), σ_to = max(sigma_min, σ_last), t = model_sampling.timestep
m_bin = (m ≥ thr)
strength∈(0,1): m' = strength·m_bin + (1−strength)·m; else m' = m_bin
Consumer KSamplerX0Inpaint: x ← x·m' + noise_scaling(σ,ε,latent)·(1−m'); out ← out·m' + latent·(1−m').

props.architectures: Any model through the KSampler inpaint wrapper; needs a denoise mask.
